results.title: LIVE UPDATES: 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila
results.content: Leaders and representatives of the 11 members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, and their allies, are gathering in Manila for the bloc's biggest event of the year

results.title: Chinese premier lauds ‘extraordinary’ ties with ASEAN ahead of Trump visit
results.content: 'We remain firmly committed to safeguarding multilateralism and promoting free trade and endeavor to make the pie bigger,' Chinese Premier Li Qiang says in remarks to ASEAN leaders in Manila
